policies.bounds: max text 8000 UTF-8 bytes; max metadata including text and cve_id 39000 bytes; list overflow counts explicit; text truncation explicit
policies.cohort: exact pinned CVEProject 2026 PUBLISHED and REJECTED partitions
policies.cvss: CNA then ADP; NVD only when both have no CVSS. Highest version within provider tier, deterministic provider tie-break. Other CVE assessments retained where bounded.
policies.cwe: CNA plus ADP; NVD fallback if no explicit CWE code
policies.description: CNA English preferred; NVD fallback only if absent
policies.legacy_enrichment: no prior inferred classification or specialized exploit-index mappings retained
policies.nvd_configurations: boolean AND/OR/negate preserved; vulnerable:false is not converted to globally unaffected
policies.remediation: CNA plus ADP solutions and workarounds; has_solution_guidance and has_workaround_guidance indicate source field presence, not availability of a working fix
policies.version_status: status changes preserved in explicit source rules; defaults only outside listed entries; unaffected does not mean fixed

snapshot_scope: Mixed snapshots: existing records unchanged; only new CVEs published after the last cutoff are added. See year_refreshes, incremental_updates, and per-record source dates.

incremental_updates.selection_policy: Source state PUBLISHED, ID absent from original published AND rejected IDs, official datePublished strictly after previous cutoff and at or before current cutoff. Original existing records remain unchanged.

cve.basis: Every CVE record JSON in the complete archive at the pinned commit; file IDs and states checked and duplicate IDs rejected.

record_policies_for_additions.cohort: Exact pinned CVEProject PUBLISHED and REJECTED partitions across every CVE ID year; no source cohort rows discarded.
record_policies_for_additions.description: CNA English preferred; ADP fallback, then NVD fallback only if absent.
record_policies_for_additions.cvss: CNA then ADP; NVD only when both have no CVSS. Highest version within provider tier, deterministic provider tie-break. Other CVE assessments retained where bounded.
record_policies_for_additions.cwe: CNA plus ADP; NVD fallback if no explicit CWE code.
record_policies_for_additions.version_status: Status changes preserved in explicit source rules; defaults only outside listed entries; unaffected does not mean fixed.
record_policies_for_additions.nvd_configurations: Boolean AND/OR/negate preserved. vulnerable:false is applicability context, never globally unaffected status.
record_policies_for_additions.remediation: CNA plus ADP solutions and workarounds. has_solution_guidance and has_workaround_guidance indicate source field presence, not fix availability.
record_policies_for_additions.legacy_enrichment: No prior inferred classifications or specialized exploit-index mappings retained.
record_policies_for_additions.bounds: Text at most 8000 UTF-8 bytes; stored metadata including text and cve_id at most39000 bytes. List omissions and text truncation explicit.
record_policies_for_additions.vendor_product_fallback: When CVE vendor/product labels are missing, NVD vulnerable:true CPE labels supply informational product filters. Full boolean applicability conditions remain authoritative; no global affected/unaffected status is inferred from these labels.
record_policies_for_additions.unknowns: Missing enrichment fields omitted; cisa_kev=false means absent from the specified complete catalog, not proof of no exploitation.
